items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: the bugs were flying in al of us in the cast. I think Giorgio Tozzi and Florence Henderson, and we all were complaining about the bugs.

ctx.x: Nanuet, New York. But we started out in Muni Opera, which was outdoors sometimes, and I remember the big trees, huge stage, and you opened your mouth and the bugs were flying in al of us in the cast. I think Giorgio Tozzi and Florence Henderson, and we all were complaining about the bugs. Then we went to Indianapolis and the Starlight Theater, another Starlight Theater. But we ended up in Nanuet, New York.
